escena: SCENE (journey mapping session, studio in Miami, golden hour): low raking golden sunlight comes through a tall window and falls ON BOTH PEOPLE, edging their shoulders and throwing their long shadows across the far side of the table; the man and the woman stand side by side leaning over a wide pale oak table covered with a long sequence of printed cards that map a gelato brand's customer journey, and she is lifting one card out of the row and setting it two places earlier at the exact moment of the decision while he keeps his finger on the gap it leaves, mid-sentence. Both look down at the cards, never at the camera. A small orange adhesive tab marks the card in her hand, and a matte deep ink-blue folder lies closed at the edge of the table. 16mm wide lens with the camera resting right on the near edge of the table, low. Everything is unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the pale oak table right against the lens
lecho.tono: VERY LIGHT, bleached pale oak lit directly by daylight, almost white
